csv_project_name: Design Service for Downtown Pawleys Island Streetscape Plan
csv_scope_of_work: Georgetown County, SC is seeking qualified firms to develop a preliminary design to enhance the walkability along this area of Highway 17, provide better and safer opportunities for the use of mass transit and cyclists using principles for a complete street , and improve and expand wayfinding signage. Traffic calming methods and revamped parking layouts should be part of the plan.
